findings.claim: FY2025 前五大直接客戶占營收 44%（2024: 36%、2023: 32%）；兩家指定客戶驅動 12%、10%，另一家直接客戶占 19%（含他人指定）；失去重要客戶可能有重大不利影響，且幾乎無合約追索權。
findings.excerpt: In each of the years, 2025, 2024 and 2023, our five largest direct customers in aggregate accounted for 44%, 36% and 32% of consolidated revenues, respectively.

findings.claim: 2025/12/31 應收帳款中兩家客戶分別占約 22% 與 20%（2024 年底各 10%）；公司稱持續做客戶信用評估，必要時要求信用狀。
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025, two customers primarily of our Semiconductor Test segment accounted for approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, of our accounts receivable balance. As of December 31, 2024, two customers of our Semiconductor Test segment each accounted for 10% of our accounts receivable balance.

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現 2026 年主要客戶信用降級、破產或下修財測的報導；Teradyne 預告 Q3 2026 營收 12–13 億美元，高於分析師預期。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（Teradyne Q2 2026 相關報導）

note: 未直接搜尋客戶評等行動（Moody's/S&P）；僅 1 次搜尋，客戶身分未揭露。
